title: Anymaker
description:
Build to SurviveEmbark on your creative journey of vehicle design, as you create and operate vehicles to navigate this dangerous open world.

Engineer AnythingAnymaker is a detailed and technical vehicle building game. Design your chassis, build your engine, connect components and cables, program controllers, and test performance. Build cars, trucks, boats, helicopters, buildings, and more.

FortifyThe only safe places are those you make. Build your bases in mountains, towns, forests, or shores in this massive open world of wilderness stretching in every direction.

Scavenge food, clothes, equipment, building parts, weapons, and other items essential to your survival.

The weather, the wildlife, the undead, the remaining military forces are yours to evade and engage.

Discover the TruthLooking for answers, your journey will lead underground to military and research complexes, explaining the events and mistakes that led to this disaster, and ultimately leading you to the solution.

Features• 6 player cooperative multiplayer support for all game features including building.

• Vehicle and structures, grid based building system.

• Massive open world featuring mountains, plains, forests, towns, industrial complexes, and more.

• Wildlife, undead, and NPC survivors.

• Sprawling underground military and research facilities.

• Day-night cycle.

• Weather simulation including wind, rain, fog, temperature, and lightning storms.

• Unlocks and progression system.

• In game voice chat and radio communication.

• Character customization.

• Hundreds of items, and inventory system.

• Melee weapons and firearms, ammunition and attachments systems.

• Microcontroller programming using drag-and-drop editor or text editing.

• Input support for either keyboard & mouse or gamepad.
description_short: Embark on your creative journey of vehicle design, as you create and operate vehicles to survive this dangerous open world. Anymaker is a detailed and technical vehicle builder and survival game. Design your chassis, build your engine, connect components, and travel into the unknown.
